req.title: Reject negative squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-023 requires HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer. The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that negative-kind tests use heuristic=NEG (not EP). Fix: change test[5] (test_post_player_large_negative_squad_number_returns_422) from heuristic=EP to heuristic=NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were. The test covers the deep negative equivalence partition (-999) which is a valid NEG heuristic application — NEG covers invalid input classes including deep-negative partitions. All other tests remain unchanged.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 does not exist in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=99 and all required fields populated
expected: Response body contains squadNumber equal to 99
trace: R-PLAYER-023: positive integer squadNumber must be accepted
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"

test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_squad_number_one_returns_409_not_422
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
squadNumber=1 already exists in the pre-loaded dataset (Anjali Banerjee)
squadNumber=1 is the minimum positive integer (boundary+1 from zero)
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=1 (minimum positive integer boundary)
Expect either 409 (duplicate) confirming the value was accepted as valid and processed, not 422
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict (not 422) — value is valid, conflict arises from duplicate
Status code is exactly 409, confirming positive integers are not rejected at validation layer
trace: R-PLAYER-023: squadNumber=1 is the minimum positive integer; must NOT return 422
BVA: boundary value immediately above the invalid/valid threshold
